theorems.name: Submission.dorag_dbs_lower_density_ge_mult
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), 0 < n → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), x ∈ W → ∀ c : ℝ, c < R.mult x → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal c * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n) ≤ R.measure (closedBall x t)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
